title: Acidic Brazilian Gobo-Burdock Soup
description: A tangy midnight soup that blends gobo and burdock root with Brazil's zestful flavors, perfect for a flexitarian craving.
instructions: Bring water to boil in a pot and add gobo slices; simmer for 15 minutes until tender.
Add diced onion and minced garlic; cook for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in black beans and sliced chili pepper; simmer for another 5 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and fresh lime juice; bring to gentle boil and reduce heat, cooking for 5 minutes.
Season with salt to taste and adjust acidity by adding more lime if desired.
Remove from heat and let the soup cool slightly before serving.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
Optionally, squeeze extra lime over each bowl for extra snap.
Serve immediately as a midnight craving delight.
